description: Check posterly's own publishing health: overall state from the last 4 hours of publishing success, any active incident (for example X being unavailable), and per-platform state with 7-day success rate and publish counts. Call it before scheduling a time-critical post, or when a user asks whether posterly or a platform is down or why posts are failing. Says so plainly when there is not enough recent activity to judge. Failures caused by content or account problems (expired connections, content limits) are excluded from the rates and reported separately as customer_side. Not the same as whoami view "status", which only reports the MCP server and npm package version. Read-only; aggregates only, no post or user data.
name: posterly_status
